knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the client buys a finished bed or area on a known date, with a fix and a clear boundary. Your hourly rate, equipment list and business age are not what is bought.
The lesson says a plant replacement window is an optional promise that should be set at a cost you can carry. An open-ended or impossible guarantee does not meet this.
The lesson says not to state a measurable result, such as no weeds for a year, unless you can show evidence for it. A famous endorsement, a discount or no evidence does not support the claim.

practicalCriteria: Applies the step to a real or simulated business decision and records the outcome
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Written output of the step (plan, offer, log or record)
stopWorkCriteria: Not applicable: business guidance; stop if an offer would make an unsubstantiated or misleading claim
